preconditions.description: The number of cities is between 2 and 2 * 10^5.
The coordinates of the cities are within the range of -10^9 to 10^9.
The type of each city is either Byteland ('B'), Berland ('R'), or disputed ('P').

preconditions.expression: Cities are given in the increasing order of their coordinates.
preconditions.description: The cities are sorted by their coordinates.
Each city has a unique coordinate.

postconditions.expression: The output is an integer representing the minimum total cost of laying cables.
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum total length of cables required to connect the cities such that both Byteland and Berland subsets are connected.
